purpose: Transfer the planner-call observation-prefix reuse test to the official DINO-WM PushT checkpoint without changing CEM semantics or running closed-loop control.

assets.staging_policy: CPU-only PBS preparation reuses two read-only archives from pusht-assets-23952308.pbs101 and directly unzips to stable ROOT/checkpoints and ROOT/data; a separate CPU-only dependency prep publishes the pinned pymunk overlay; one later A100 PBS job only reads these stable results
assets.archive_policy: CPU preparation uses system unzip with outputs/pusht/* and pusht_noise/*; target directories must not exist before preparation and frozen required files are tested before marker publication
assets.missing_assets_policy: the CPU-only prep job requires both prior-job ZIPs and fails closed if either is missing; the A100 job requires the stable directories and marker and does not call the historical Python preparer
assets.hash_policy: no checksum or hash is computed

runtime_dependencies.scikit_image: 0.21.0 binary-wheel compatibility version for Python 3.11; official 0.19.3 has no CPython 3.11 wheel
runtime_dependencies.gpu_dependency: A100 job must be submitted with afterok dependencies on both successful CPU-only asset and dependency prep jobs
runtime_dependencies.install_policy: only-binary pip install in CPU allocation; no login-node install, compile, or hash

protocol.target_preparation: official PlanWorkspace dset path with seed=99 and goal_H=5, including PushTEnv replay before the timed direct CEM calls
protocol.environment_dependency: official PushTEnv requires pymunk, pygame, shapely and skimage for target preparation; the CPU-only dependency prep job bootstraps pip in the extracted temporary runtime and installs binary wheels pymunk==6.8.0, pygame==2.5.2, shapely==2.0.3, numpy<2 and Python-3.11-compatible scikit-image==0.21.0 into the versioned stable PYTHONPATH overlay
protocol.timed_planner: direct CEMPlanner.plan only; no MPC outer loop or environment action execution

cache_boundary.name: factorized_cache
cache_boundary.suffix: encode_act, predictor, replace_actions_from_z, objective and candidate-specific CEM updates
cache_boundary.scope: one complete CEMPlanner.plan call; one prefix per fixed observation, expanded as a read-only view to each candidate batch
cache_boundary.baseline: official wm.rollout on the candidate-repeated observation

timing.measurement_unit: one complete direct CEMPlanner.plan call for one fixed PushT observation/goal pair and one paired RNG seed
timing.technical_repeat_unit: the observation/planner call, not an individual candidate or CEM iteration
timing.timing_boundary: planner.plan entry through returned actions, including preprocessing, goal encoding, start-prefix encoding/cache setup, all CEM iterations and trace logging
timing.device_synchronization: torch.cuda.synchronize immediately before and after each timed call

decision_gate.fallback: If any trace is not bitwise exact, accept only when every final action, final first action, per-iteration elite/topk trace, mu, sigma and best-loss value differs by at most 1e-5.
decision_gate.decision_trace: final actions, final first actions, one best-loss value per CEM iteration, and each iteration's elite indices/losses/mu/sigma/first action
decision_gate.action_conditioning_requirement: factorized start prefix is detached; action encoding, predictor calls, action replacement and CEM ranking/update remain on the official path

progression_gate.purpose: Authorize a later LeWorldModel PushT test only when the bounded DINO-WM PushT transfer is numerically safe and materially useful.
progression_gate.decision_required: decision gate PASS (bitwise exact or every frozen max-abs comparison <= 1e-5)
progression_gate.timing_statistic: median technical-repeat latency per observation, then median of the two paired reductions; reduction = 1 - factorized_cache / baseline
progression_gate.rule: PASS only when decision gate passes, paired median full-plan latency reduction >= 0.10, and maximum cached-to-baseline peak-memory ratio <= 1.10; otherwise stop and do not begin LeWorldModel PushT.

prohibited: Do not change the official PushT checkpoint/config, objective, CEM settings or paired RNG seeds between paths.
Do not include MPC outer-loop environment action execution or closed-loop success in this validation.
Do not tune the numerical threshold or progression gates after observing results.

Do not download, extract, install, compile or hash assets/dependencies on a login node; stable asset preparation and the pinned pymunk overlay are permitted only through guarded CPU-only PBS prep allocations, and the later guarded A100 job must only read their results.
